metadata.title: Experiment 2.1: Robustness and Streaming Audit of Constrained Forward-Only RLS

rank_detection.unpivoted_qr_failure_details: Unpivoted QR leaves zero pivots in non-terminal diagonal positions for non-contiguous dependent columns, causing Q[:, rank:] to intersect the safeguard column span and leak constraints (leakage up to 2.63e+00). Furthermore, a fixed 1e-10 threshold fails in float32 due to machine epsilon ~1.19e-7.
rank_detection.svd_rank_agreement: 100% agreement across float32 and float64 with dtype-aware tolerance

streaming_memory.asymptotic_state_memory_complexity: O(d_red^2 + d_in * d_red + d_out * d_red + (d_in + d_out) * m)

experiment_2_reconciliations.configuration_count: Experiment 2 executed and verified exactly 37 configurations (Sweep 2 contained 7 configurations: m in [0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 16, 24], making 6 + 7 + 6 + 6 + 5 + 4 + 2 + 1 = 37 total runs). The concluding sentence of the Experiment 2 report had an informal typographical mention of '36', which is now reconciled to the authoritative 37 recorded in metrics_summary.json and raw_results.json.
experiment_2_reconciliations.transformer_scale_latency: The authoritative steady-state per-update latency on the tested dual-core 4-thread hardware for d_in=896, d_out=256 is 79.56 ms (matching metrics_summary.json in Experiment 2). The conversational mention of 23.1 ms was from a preliminary scout run with non-matching configuration.
